en.name: Rainbow Spider
en.effect: If this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 Insect monster from your hand or GY. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Insect Xyz Monster you control; detach 1 material from that monster you control, and if you do, Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "Number" monster that is 1 Rank higher than that monster, by using it as material (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer its materials), also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Rainbow Spider" once per turn.

ja.name: レインボー・スパイダー
